rulings.rationale: Re-running git_log_analyze with explicit bug-fix patterns over 24 months returned only 2 commits, whereas the proposer claimed 4.
The proposer claimed 100 distinct committers in 12 months, which is highly improbable for this project size; a sample of recent commits shows mostly bots and a few maintainers.

notes: Disputed bug fix count and highly suspect maintainer activity metrics.
